content.text:
The ticket is already categorized as billing, so I didn't need to relabel it. The classifier's "Credit card" result is a complaint product label, not a ticket category, so I didn't use it.

Reply to the customer:

Hi Maria, thank you for reporting the duplicate $9.99 charge for Lumen Plus. We've logged your request with billing, and a member of our team will review both charges on your account. We'll follow up with you once that review is complete.
